newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lagardere had better industrial plan - Govt.
newsitem.headline: Lagardere had better industrial plan - Govt.

text.p: French finance minister Jean Arthuis said on Wednesday the government had decided to sell Thomson SA for a symbolic one franc to Lagardere as this company had a better industrial plan than rival bidder Alcatel Alsthom.
"The offers were comparable on a financial level. They both needed a capital increase," he told a news conference.

Industry minister Franck Borotra said Lagardere's intended merger of Thomson-CSF with Matra would create a strong French defence pole while Daewoo Electronics' mass production experience would be an asset to Thomson Multimedia.
Defence minister Charles Millon said the choice was between a horizontal integration with Alcatel or vertical integration with Matra.
The government had decided for a vertical integration but Alcatel would continue to play a major role in these activities.
Arthuis said the 11 billion francs capital injection would be financed from other privatisation receipts.
"I will disclose the source (of the money) at the appropriate time," he said.
Arthuis also said that the European Commission would have to study the deal not only because of injection of state funds but also because of competition issues.
